Read the Go build information (go version -m) of /usr/bin/alertmanager and /usr/bin/amtool in every published build of the alertmanager-dev package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, on both x86_64 and aarch64: 36 builds, 0.31.1-r0 through 0.35.0-r2. Each is a statically linked Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0. go.opentelemetry.io/otel is v1.40.0 in 0.31.1-r0 to 0.31.1-r5 and v1.43.0 from 0.31.1-r6; every later build carries v1.43.0 to v1.47.0. Every download was checked against the checksum in the package index. Checked against the function names recorded in each program's Go function table (pclntab): in every build both binaries contain a function the advisory names in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/internal/global, (*textMapPropagator).SetDelegate, and alertmanager also contains global.Error, global.Warn, global.SetTextMapPropagator and global.SetTracerProvider; neither contains the advisory's baggage.New, baggage.Parse or propagation.Baggage.Extract. So 0.31.1-r6 is the first build with a fixed module, and the earlier builds carry v1.40.0, which is in the affected range.

CVE-2026-29181 (GHSA-mh2q-q3fh-2475, GO-2026-5506): in go.opentelemetry.io/otel 1.36.0 through 1.40.0, extracting a request whose baggage header carries many values makes excessive allocations, a remote denial-of-service amplification. It is fixed in 1.41.0, which applies the W3C Baggage limits: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-mh2q-q3fh-2475, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/pull/7880, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/commit/aa1894e09e3fe66860c7885cb40f98901b35277f, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/releases/tag/v1.41.0. Read the Go build information and the function table of every Go program in every build-dev package published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository: 89 builds, 2.6.4-r0 through the current 2.29.1-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64 except 2.6.4-r0, which is published for aarch64 only, every download checked against the index checksum. Each package holds one file, the Go program /usr/bin/build. Version 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times in each index, every entry with the same source commit and installed size as 2.19.1-r0; the copy the repository serves was read. The functions the advisory lists, go.opentelemetry.io/otel/baggage.Parse and New and propagation.Baggage.Extract, are linked into /usr/bin/build in every build. Every build before 2.16.6-r0 carries go.opentelemetry.io/otel 1.40.0, which is affected. From 2.16.6-r0 on, every Go program in the package that contains go.opentelemetry.io/otel carries 1.41.0 or later; the current 2.29.1-r1 has 1.47.0.

The Go vulnerability database lists baggage New and Parse, propagation Baggage.Extract and, in internal/global, Debug, ErrDelegator.Handle, Error, GetErrorHandler, Info, SetErrorHandler, SetMeterProvider, SetTextMapPropagator, SetTracerProvider, Warn and textMapPropagator.SetDelegate as the affected functions. We read every published external-dns-fips package for Alpine 3.23 in the authenticated DHI Alpine security repository, x86_64 and aarch64: 33 versions, 0.20.0-r0 to 0.24.0-r5, each matching its repository index checksum. CVE-2026-29181 (GO-2026-5506, GHSA-mh2q-q3fh-2475): go.opentelemetry.io/otel's baggage propagator made excessive allocations when extracting a request with many baggage header values, which can cause a denial of service. Versions 1.36.0 up to 1.41.0 are affected. It is fixed in go.opentelemetry.io/otel 1.41.0: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5506, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-mh2q-q3fh-2475, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/releases/tag/v1.41.0. We read the Go build information and the Go function table (.gopclntab, which is kept even in stripped Go programs) of /usr/bin/metrics-server, the one file the package ships, in every published metrics-server-dev package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository (29 versions, 0.8.1-r0 to 0.9.1-r2, x86_64 and aarch64; each download matched the index checksum). In each version the metrics-server, metrics-server-dev, metrics-server-fips and metrics-server-fips-dev packages are built with the same Go toolchain and the same module versions; the -fips packages are built in Go's FIPS 140-3 mode, and the -dev packages are linked without -w and with full source paths, so they keep the DWARF debug information that the metrics-server and metrics-server-fips programs drop (all four keep the Go symbol table). The advisory's vulnerable functions go.opentelemetry.io/otel/baggage.Parse and baggage.New and go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation.Baggage.Extract are in the function table of every build, so the status follows the module version. 0.8.1-r0 to 0.8.1-r6 use go.opentelemetry.io/otel 1.40.0, inside the affected range; 0.8.1-r7 and every later build use go.opentelemetry.io/otel 1.43.0 to 1.47.0, which carry the fix.
